Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misinterpretation of fundamental thermodynamic principles regarding the direction of heat flow. The agent incorrectly concluded that thermal energy flows in "both directions" or that the net flow is ambiguous, failing to recognize the basic scientific law that heat spontaneously flows from a region of higher temperature (hot tea) to a region of lower temperature (ice) until thermal equilibrium is reached. This led to the selection of an incorrect option (C) instead of the correct one (B).
